# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 28 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Update

- **NDR 2026: BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000, EC ceiling to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally that the HDB BTO household income ceiling has been raised to S$16,000 and the Executive Condominium ceiling to S$18,000. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **Bedok 5-room flat sells for a record $1.45M** - A five-room flat at 153B Bedok South Road sold for $1,450,000 ($1,192 psf) in August 2026, setting a new resale record for Bedok and surpassing the previous record set at the same block just three months earlier. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bedok-5-room-hdb-sold-record-1-45m-same-block-broke-record-3-months-ago/)

- **Bishan 4-room flat becomes the first in the town to hit S$1.3M** - A 4-room HDB resale flat in Bishan changed hands for S$1.3 million in August 2026 at approximately S$1,271 psf, marking the first time a Bishan 4-room flat has reached that price level. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

- **Pasir Ris DBSS flat sets new record at $1.15M — $167K above the previous high** - A five-room DBSS flat at 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for $1,150,000 ($1,018 psf) in August 2026, setting a new resale record for the flat type in Pasir Ris. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/5-room-pasir-ris-dbss-flat-set-a-new-1-15m-record-167k-above-previous-high/)

## Private Residential Market

- **Singapore prime home prices grew just 0.4% in H1 2026, with a stronger H2 forecast** - Prime rents rose 1.7% in H1 2026, ahead of the 1.1% global average, and Savills forecasts prime capital values to grow 2% to 3.9% in H2 2026, placing Singapore among the strongest outlooks of 30 cities tracked. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-prime-home-prices-grew-0-4-first-half-2026-2-signs-point-stronger-second-half/)

- **Condo resale activity rebounds in July 2026 as prices edge lower** - More condo resale units changed hands in July 2026 compared to the prior month, though overall prices edged lower and volume remained slightly below last year's level and the typical figure for the month. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-rebounds-in-july-2026-as-prices-edge-lower/)
